rationale: The original thesis required reclaiming the 5-min VWAP at $16.46, but price explicitly rejected that level on expanding volume (123K–150K distribution candles at the $16.45–$16.46 zone) and has since drifted back below both the VWAP and the 9-EMA ($16.32), now sitting at $16.30 with the last several candles printing lower highs and lower lows on declining volume — a stalling, not a re-accumulation. The maximum favorable excursion of 1.54% has faded to 0.68%, the structure that justified the long is broken, and with 249 minutes remaining there is meaningful drift risk back toward the $15.88 invalidation; locking in the residual gain is preferable to riding a failed breakout structure.
